text:
The Walking Dead: Daryl Dixon Final Season - Official Teaser Trailer (2027) Norman Reedus
For hope. For home. For each other. Check out the teaser for the final season of The Walking Dead: Daryl Dixon. The Walking Dead: Daryl Dixon series stars Norman Reedus and Melissa McBride as Daryl and Carol in this new season set in Spain. Jimmy Smits (NYPD Blue, The West Wing) joins the cast in the new season. The Walking Dead: Daryl Dixon premieres on AMC and AMC+ in 2027.

In the final season, while crossing the ravaged badlands of Spain, Daryl (Reedus) and Carol (McBride) grasp onto hope – and each other – as uncertainty about their future grows. Smits plays “Captain Alejandro Perkins,” a former U.S. Navy officer and medical doctor who found a unique way to thrive during the apocalypse. 

The Walking Dead: Daryl Dixon also stars Romain Levi, Eduardo Noriega, Óscar Jaenada, Candela Saitta and Hugo Arbués and is executive produced by showrunner David Zabel, Scott M. Gimple, Reedus, McBride, Greg Nicotero, Brian Bockrath, Angela Kang, Jason Richman, Dan Percival and Steve Squillante.

Azuki - Official Manga Trailer (2026)
Some bonds are stronger than fate. Check out the trailer for Azuki, an upcoming original manga created by artist Arnold Tsang, former Character Art Director for Overwatch. The series premieres September 17 at 9:00 AM PDT and will be available to read free exclusively on Azuki.com, with new chapters releasing on the third Thursday of every month. This cinematic trailer for Azuki introduces you to the manga's world: a story of two sisters, ancient Gates, and a bond tested across worlds.

When Shao's sister Rei disappears beyond the mysterious Gates, her search pulls her into a conflict that threatens both worlds. As long-buried secrets emerge, Shao must confront impossible choices that will test family bonds, trust, and destiny.

text:
Everything Nintendo Announced at the Zelda 40th Anniversary Direct - IGN Daily Fix
In today's Daily Fix:
Nintendo has finally shown us gameplay for the highly anticipated The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake, along with first looks at a new LEGO set, Zelda amiibo, a very cool replica Master Sword, and more. Unfortunately not much was shown from the upcoming Zelda live-action movie, but we did get an official logo. In other news, GTA 6's global release times have been confirmed, and U.S. gamers can boot it up starting midnight Eastern time, November 19th (meaning West Coast gamers can start a few hours early at 9pm Pacific). And finally, Capcom's streak continues with Onimusha: Way of the Sword selling one million copies so far. Capcom is now considering reviving other dormant IPs, which means we may finally get that Dino Crisis reboot.

text:
Godzilla Minus Zero - Official Trailer (2026)
Check out the new trailer for Godzilla Minus Zero, the upcoming film follow-up to the 2023 movie, Godzilla Minus One. 

War reduced Japan to zero, and Godzilla plunged it into minus. Two years have passed since then, and the country has faced agonizing struggles to achieve recovery and finally reclaim its daily life.

Just as humanity managed to cling to a hard-won peace, a new threat strikes, crushing hope in an instant.

There is no third time. Everything ends here.

Ryunosuke Kamiki returns as Koichi Shikishima, the hero who stood against Godzilla’s terror in Godzilla Minus One, and is joined by Minami Hamabe as Noriko Shikishima, who miraculously survived Godzilla’s first attack on Tokyo. Min Tanaka joins the cast in the pivotal role of Kanji Murakami, a biologist carrying deep psychological scars from the war. 

Additionally, Hidetaka Yoshioka reprises his role as Kenji Noda, who fought alongside protagonist Koichi Shikishima in Godzilla Minus One and now battles the new threat as the director of the Disaster Response Bureau. Yuki Yamada returns as Shiro Mizushima, the young crew member of the Shinseimaru who fought on the front lines, alongside Kuranosuke Sasaki as Seiji Akitsu, the captain of the same vessel. Furthermore, Sakura Ando reprises her role as Sumiko Ota, Shikishima's neighbor who now runs a local orphanage, and Miou Tanaka returns as Tatsuo Hotta, the former captain of the destroyer Yukikaze.

New cast members include Masami Nagasawa, who joins as Makoto Aoyama, a genius weather forecaster assigned to the Disaster Response Bureau. Further cast additions include Jun Kunimura, cast as Dr. Ogata, and Ko Maehara as Professor Murakami’s (Min Tanaka) assistant Akira Hagiwara. Additionally, Motosuke Iida is confirmed to reprise his role as Akio Itagaki, the Toyo Balloon section chief who made significant contributions to the Godzilla extermination operation in Godzilla Minus One. Further cast additions include Kenji Misuhashi, Eita Okuno, and Kai Inowaki.

Godzilla Minus Zero, directed by Takashi Yamazaki, will make its world premiere as the Spotlight Gala selection for the 64th New York Film Festival on Saturday, September 26. The wide theatrical release across North America begins November 6, 2026. It will debut in Japan on November 3, 2026.

Unico Traveller ULW10 - Official Trailer
Check out the trailer for the Unico Traveller ULW10 portable display. Unico Traveller ULW10 features a 10-inch 4:3 retro-inspired display, RGBs input for classic gaming hardware, VGA input for vintage PCs and compatible hardware, HDMI input for modern consoles and devices, physical RGB color adjustment controls, physical display and menu controls, integrated speaker, built-in rear compartment for compatible consoles, cables and accessories, integrated carrying handles for portability, and it is available in multiple color options.

Designed for those who still own the consoles and games they grew up with, the ULW10 brings classic hardware back into the modern setup with a portable, PVM-inspired 4:3 display built for generations of gaming.

A Kickstarter campaign for the Unico Traveller ULW10 is now live.
